method.percentile: linear interpolation, rank = q * (n - 1), over the sorted sample
method.stress: 16 observers x 100 metadata reads each (the same rotating read set), barrier-started so the whole burst is simultaneous, while the active-run driver keeps a run live; NON-REFERENCE and NON-GATING — it exists to make the D13 async-single-loop (blocking SQLite on one event loop) disclosure honest, not to gate anything
method.timer: time.perf_counter around each GatewayClient call (stdlib only)
